3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Preparation:
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop was filled according to the experimental plan prior to starting the ÄKTA run.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Run:
    • The ÄKTA Pure system was started with a predefined protocol.
    • Primary signals recorded included UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond).
    • Sample data were acquired with a sampling time of 1 s.
